st: The tangle of language and consciousness, lit up by GPT

sec.p: In 🎼 ff.81 2024 in the history books we saw that 2024 could go down in history as the annus mirabilis of handing over our cognitive abilities.
Consciousness is choosing what to focus our (ever more bombarded) attention on.

Autocomplete. Large Language Models (LLMs) amazed us with their “emergent” abilities (like translating, writing code, putting together recipes), even though they were only trained to predict the most likely word to complete a sentence.

sec.t: ff.83.4 Why writing and thinking matter
sec.p: Buried under texts “vomited” by GPT, Tim Ferriss answers his son's question on his blog: does writing still make sense?

sec.t: ff.83.5 Understanding the brain with AI
sec.p: In this merry-go-round between AI and the human mind, here's Anthropic, a company founded by OpenAI defectors.
